description: Phase 6br gate — subquery-in-FROM (derived tables). Parser + compiler extension: FROM (SELECT ...) AS alias materializes the inner SELECT as a virtual table.

program.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT a FROM t) AS sub ORDER BY a;
SELECT a FROM (SELECT a FROM t WHERE a > 2) AS sub ORDER BY a;
SELECT a FROM (SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a LIMIT 3) AS sub;

cases.name: derived-aggregate-inside
cases.description: Aggregation occurs inside the derived table; outer query projects the result.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (k INTEGER, v INTEGER);
SELECT k, s FROM (SELECT k, SUM(v) AS s FROM t GROUP BY k) AS agg ORDER BY k;

cases.name: derived-outer-where
cases.description: Outer WHERE references derived-table columns via the alias.

program.sql: SELECT sub.a FROM (SELECT a FROM t) AS sub WHERE sub.a >= 3 ORDER BY sub.a;
SELECT x.a, y.a FROM (SELECT a FROM t) AS x, (SELECT a FROM t) AS y ORDER BY x.a, y.a;
SELECT sub.a, u.b FROM (SELECT a FROM t) AS sub, u ORDER BY sub.a, u.b;

cases.name: derived-projected-alias
cases.description: Inner SELECT uses an explicit alias; outer query references it.

program.sql: SELECT sub.doubled FROM (SELECT a * 2 AS doubled FROM t) AS sub ORDER BY sub.doubled;

cases.name: derived-missing-alias-rejected
cases.description: Derived table without a trailing alias must be rejected at parse time.
